# issue 4036 -- per-release matrix: repro, feature-presence control, workaround
#
# Generated by release-matrix.py, which echoes every command it runs.
# Stable releases only; prereleases are outside the search by policy and
# this issue names none.  Exit codes are the raw 32-bit process status.
#   0x00000000             -- compiled clean
#   0x00000001             -- driver rejected the command line
#   0x80004005 E_FAIL      -- ordinary diagnosed error (NOT an internal failure)
#   0x80AA001D DXC_E_LLVM_CAST_ERROR -- internal failure
#
# Each case is run twice, with and without the `-HV 2021` from the issue's
# original title.  IDENTITY says whether the two runs agree on exit status
# and on every byte of output; that is the equivalence control for dropping
# the flag from cmd.txt.
